How can I check my UAE visa status with Emirates ID?

The first thing you need to know is that there are many visas that people can apply for in the UAE. That is, if you want to do the visa status check by passport number or Emirates ID, it is good to know some of the most important visa types. That is why in this section you will see what these types of visas are, so you can know which one you have and how to check its status.

  • Tourist visa: This type of visa is ideal for people who want to enter the UAE for tourism purposes. Generally, it has a short validity of between 30 to 90 days and can be obtained through a travel agency. Another option is to go directly to the immigration center in the UAE.
  • Employment visa: People who want to seek employment in the United Arab Emirates need a work visa.. Generally, the duration is a maximum of two years and you have the possibility of requesting renewal.
  • Residence visa: If a person obtains a work visa, he or she can apply for a residence visa. Residence visas in UAE gives people the option to live in the UAE legally for a longer period. Generally, it is valid for a maximum of three years depending on the employer’s sponsorship.
  • Student visa: Any student intending to study in the United Arab Emirates has to apply for a student visa. Generally, this visa is only for people with admission into a major educational institution in the country.
  • Visit visa: A visit visa is ideal for people who wish to visit their friends or family in the UAE. In addition, you need the sponsorship of a resident or citizen of the UAE.

Easy Guide: Verifying UAE Visa Status Using Your Emirates ID

If you do not know the status of your UAE visa, you must take immediate action. This way, you can avoid any type of problem. Navigating Visa Status Checks: Step-by-Step with Emirates ID

One of the most frequently asked questions is how to check visa status using Passport number UAE or Emirates ID. Therefore, if you are a UAE resident, you will be able to check your visa status with Emirates ID by following these steps:

  • First step: Enter the ICP Smart Services portal.
  • Second step: You have to click where it says Emirates ID.
  • Third step: According to your type of visa you will have to select residence or visa.
  • Fourth step: Enter your Emirates ID number.
  • Fifth step: In the drop-down menu you must select your nationality.
  • Sixth step: Check the box with captcha verification.
  • Seventh step: You have to click on the search tab.
  • Eighth step: If all the information you provide is correct, the page will display all the details regarding your visa. This way, you will be able to see your visa status and details such as the date your UAE visa expires.

On the other hand, you can check the status of your visa with your passport number. However, to do this in the second step you will have to click on the tab that says passport information. This way, in the fourth step you will have to enter your passport number and not your Emirates ID.

  • There are usually technical issues that may affect the verification of your visa status. This may be caused by software updates or maintenance.
